But one feature that Earth and Mars share among the eight planets in our solar system are polar ice caps. Both are one of each planet’s striking features, but the major difference is while Earth’s polar ice caps are both comprised of water, Mars’ north polar ice cap is only comprised of water while its southern polar ice cap is carbon dioxide. The reasons for this are determined by altitude, but Mars’ northern polar ice cap is one of the most studied regions primarily due to its water ice composition. items.title: Final Fantasy XIV Online's Sixth Expansion 'Evercold' Launches February 2027
items.summary: New job and much more revealed. Now that the MMORPG Final Fantasy XIV Online is available on the Switch 2, Square Enix is looking towards the game's sixth expansion, Evercold . We previously heard how it would be coming in January 2027, and now at the Final Fantasy XIV Fan Fest in Tokyo this weekend, Square Enix has announced the date has been shifted to 23rd February 2027 . Pre-orders will begin on 4th November 2026 , with early access opening on 19th February 2027 . Read the full article on nintendolife.com
